# Bundled HHTools snapshot

Source: https://github.com/Roboparty/human-humanoid-tools
Version: 0.1.0. This is the exact local source archive used by the successful
AMP three-group Isaac smoke test (amp_real_smoke_20261028). The archive did not
contain upstream Git metadata, so no upstream commit is claimed.

`hhtools/` contains the unchanged Python package and its resources, configs,
pyproject.toml, upstream README, Apache-2.0 LICENSE and NOTICE. Generated bytecode,
environments, desktop builds, robot assets and external datasets are excluded.
File SHA256 values are recorded in hhtools_snapshot.json; the installer verifies
them before running. `.gitattributes` preserves original source bytes on checkout.
Third-party notices and resource attributions inside the package are retained.

Newton, Warp and other binary dependencies are installed separately by pip into
an isolated Python 3.12 environment. This is not an offline wheel bundle. Server
package-index access is still required. No SMPL model weights are bundled or
required by this robot-to-robot reference-generation path.

From the repository root, while the training environment is active:

```bash
python robolab/experiments/amp_hybrid/setup_hhtools.py
```

This creates or reuses `amp_hhtools`, rejects an incompatible Python version,
installs pinned core dependencies plus the bundled editable package, checks pip
dependencies, snapshot hashes, actual import location and retargeting imports.
It never installs into base, robo_cjl or the active conda environment. Use
`--dry-run` to inspect commands without creating an environment or installing.

Retain the vendor path after installation: the editable installation and
reference-library source identity depend on these exact files.
